problem_definition.core_issue: Non-production transcription data (mock/degraded) wordt downstream verwerkt
problem_definition.business_impact: Pipeline verwerkt mock data wat tot foutieve clips leidt
problem_definition.current_behavior: Mock transcriptions worden doorgestuurd naar detect_moments en video cutting
problem_definition.desired_behavior: Pipeline stopt bij non-production transcript en informeert gebruiker

implementation_specification.exact_code_snippet:
# Pipeline Guard - Stop on non-production transcripts
tr = transcription_result
if not tr.get('allow_downstream', True):
    logger.warning('Transcription not production-grade (mock/degraded). Halting pipeline.')
    job.status = 'needs_real_transcript'
    job.user_message = tr.get('user_message') or 'Transcriptie is niet gelukt. Probeer opnieuw met compressie/chunks.'
    session.commit()
    return {
        'success': False,
        'stopped_at': 'transcription',
        'reason': 'non_production_transcript',
        'user_message': job.user_message
    }
